steps.text: In a chemical change, a brand-new substance is formed. Let's make one happen.
Pick a reaction — tap “Vinegar + Baking Soda”.
Now tap “Mix the Chemicals” and watch.
It fizzes and produces a new gas (carbon dioxide) — that bubbling is the sign a new substance has formed.
Unlike a physical change, a chemical change makes new substances and usually can't be reversed.

coach.mission: Mix the chemicals and spot the sign of a new substance.
whenStuck: Pick a reaction first, then tap “Mix the Chemicals”.
Watch for fizzing, colour change, heat, or a gas — signs of a new substance.
whenWrong: A chemical change forms a new substance — look for bubbles, colour change or heat.
The fizzing gas is the new substance, so this is a chemical change.
whenCorrect: Right — a new substance (the gas) formed. That's a chemical change.
Good — and a chemical change usually can't be undone.
coach.done: You've made a chemical change and seen a new substance form. Try another, or move on when you're ready.
